items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: I took Ellis Larkins with me... if you don't want to play what I want you to play... there's another little piano player around the corner. He won't be no Ellis Larkins but he'll play.

ctx.x: Yeah. And one time I took Ellis Larkins with me, and him and Major, I think it was, they shared a suite. But there were two bedrooms, two baths, a kitchen, and a dining room and living room, you know. And then they would have people come in and cater a party for us.

items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...talk about Ellis Larkin too... [INTERVIEWEE] He's one of the greatest piano players.

ctx.x: Well that's what the accompanist is all about.

Yeah, for a singer. To anticipate and know. Well listen, I think we ought to talk about Ellis Larkin too because we're talking about personalities as well as piano players. Well he's a very funny man.
He's one of the greatest piano players.
